seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: MIS (LOBs CFG, SFG, FIG, PPIF, MIS Other) and MA (LOBs RD&A, ERS, PS). Revenue by LOB = external revenue (release Table 2); MIS intersegment = royalty charged to MA; MA intersegment = fees charged to MIS; elim = Eliminations column of the release segment table (revenue row). Segment Adjusted Operating Income, adjusted margins, D&A, restructuring, other items and segment operating income from the release "Financial Information by Segment" table (segment revenue there includes intersegment). mis_recurring / ma_recurring = "Relationship" revenue and *_transaction = "Transaction" revenue from release "Transaction and Relationship Revenue" table. mis_ratings_total not shown (null). Annual: twelve-month block of the Q4 release; the 10-K segment note gives identical Adjusted Operating Income, D&A, restructuring and other items (10-K wins; no differences). 2019 LOB realignments (Q1-19): REIT revenue moved from SFG to CFG; Bureau van Dijk FACT product moved from RD&A to ERS (prior-year LOB revenue reclassified in 2019 releases). ASC 842 adopted 1-Jan-2019 (operating lease ROU assets and lease liabilities on BS). From 2019 overhead allocation uses a fixed "Baseline Pool" (10-K). Q4-19 / FY19 release transaction-relationship table splits MA into RD&A / ERS / PS; ma_recurring/transaction use the "Total MA" row.

Table 12 - 2020 Outlook
Moody's outlook for 2020 is based on assumptions about many geopolitical conditions and macroeconomic and capital market factors, including interest rates, foreign currency exchange rates, corporate profitability and business investment
spending, mergers and acquisitions, consumer borrowing and securitization, and the amount of debt issued. These assumptions are subject to uncertainty, and results for the year could differ materially from our current outlook. Our guidance
assumes timely closing of the recently announced acquisition of Regulatory DataCorp and assumes foreign currency translation at end-of-quarter exchange rates. Specifically, our forecast reflects exchange rates for the British pound (£) of $1.31
to £1 and for the euro (€) of $1.11 to €1.
